name: app-6ad9e89b47d081918d544bc401231b68
description: Fill official and template PDF forms on pdfformly.com from a conversation

interface.longDescription: Pick a form such as W-9, I-9, W-2 or SS-4, answer its questions in the chat, sign with a saved signature, review every answer, and get the finished PDF. Drafts are saved in your PDFFormly account. ID numbers such as SSNs and EINs are typed on pdfformly.com, never in the chat. Never asks for passwords or card numbers.
defaultPrompt: Help me fill out a W-9 for a new client.
I need to fill Form I-9 for my new job. Ask me the questions one section at a time.
I'm starting an LLC and need an EIN. Help me fill out Form SS-4.

positive.description: Find a form by its number without linking an account
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card of matching forms with Form W-9 first. No sign-in is needed for searching.

positive.description: Start a W-9 draft and save answers (first use links the PDFFormly account with the test credentials)
positive.prompt: Help me fill out a W-9. My name is Jane Sample, I'm an individual/sole proprietor, address 100 Main St, Austin, TX 78701.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to connect PDFFormly (sign in with the reviewer account, click Allow), starts a W-9 draft, saves the given answers, and asks only for anything still missing. It does not invent values and does not ask for the SSN or EIN in the chat; once the other answers are saved it gives a short PDFFormly link (no sign-in) where the user types it, then continues when the user says done.

positive.description: Reject an invalid answer and ask again
positive.prompt: Change the signing date on my W-9 to February 30, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: The server refuses the date (February 30 does not exist) and ChatGPT asks for a valid date instead of saving it.

positive.description: Sign with a saved signature and review the answers
positive.prompt: Sign my W-9 with my saved signature and show me a review.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the reviewer account's saved signatures as a card; after the user picks one it is applied, then a review card lists every answer and asks whether everything is correct.

positive.description: Create the PDF only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Yes, everything is correct. Create the PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the PDF with confirmed=true and shows a Download PDF card; the link opens the filled, signed W-9 (valid 30 minutes).

negative.description: Unrelated request; PDFFormly tools should not be called. Expected: ChatGPT answers normally without the app.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: A government ID number typed in the chat. Expected: the app does not save or repeat it; ChatGPT gives the PDFFormly link where the user types the SSN themselves.
negative.prompt: My SSN is 123-45-6789, put it on my W-9.

negative.description: Payment or card details in chat. Expected: the app never takes card numbers or charges; it points to pdfformly.com for plans and purchases.
negative.prompt: Here is my credit card 4242 4242 4242 4242, buy a PDFFormly plan for me.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search forms, fill them by chat with validated answers, sign with saved signatures, review every answer, and download the PDF. ID numbers (SSN, EIN, ITIN, passport) are typed on pdfformly.com, never in the chat.
